title: Fix Ui React Script Import Depth And Project Cwd
description: In ui/js/react/script.ts, the relative imports "../../repo/lib/js/index.ts" (lines 3-7) resolve to ui/repo/lib/js/index.ts, which doesn't exist, because the package lives at ui/js/react (3 levels deep) but the import only goes up 2 levels. Fix to "../../../repo/lib/js/index.ts". Also ui/js/react/project.json had all targets set "cwd": "ui/react" which should be "cwd": "ui/js/react". This broke bun ./script.ts test/lint/build/dev/typecheck and the corresponding nx run @semio-tech/ui-react:* targets for the whole ui-react package. Verify by running cd ui/js/react && bun ./script.ts test and bunx nx run @semio-tech/ui-react:test.
summary: Fixed broken build tooling for the ui-react package: script.ts imported "../../repo/lib/js/index.ts" (2 levels up) but the package lives 3 levels deep (ui/js/react), so the import resolved to nonexistent ui/repo/lib/js/index.ts — changed to "../../../repo/lib/js/index.ts". project.json's targets (dev/build/lint/test/typecheck) all set cwd to the stale path "ui/react" instead of "ui/js/react" — corrected all five. Verified with `bun ./script.ts test` (vitest now runs, no "Cannot find module" error) and `bunx nx run @semio-tech/ui-react:test` (nx correctly resolves cwd and invokes the same vitest run). 9 pre-existing test failures remain (PointerEvent not defined in jsdom, tree-branch-elbow/stem markup mismatches) — unrelated to this fix, not addressed.
